title: Deshaun Watson on future with Browns: That's up to my agent, I don't worry about that

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deshaun Watson on future with Browns: That's up to my agent, I don't worry about that
sources.description: After several years marred by poor play and injuries, Deshaun Watson has provided some return on the investment the Browns made with the infamous 2022 trade to acquire him.
